identity_header.policy: filled event-specific values may anchor identity; unrelated administrative fields are not repair knowledge

special_notes.policy: preserve full section; printed boilerplate is template context only; event-specific handwriting/typed additions require human review

repairs_replacements.policy: meaningful filled-in content is preserved even without a repaired/replaced mark; marks are attributes of content, not admission gates

global_ignores.policy: retain for raw/audit only; never testing evidence, final-result evidence, initials/date evidence, terminology evidence, association signal, or Qdrant knowledge
